name: terminal-plus
description: Airport concierge for Singapore Changi (SIN), Terminals 1 to 4 and Jewel: places to eat, rest and shop, live flight status, delays and layover plans. Read-only, no login.

tools.name: get_airport_context
tools.title: Flight status and boarding time
tools.description: Use when a traveller gives a flight number and asks "which terminal and gate?", "when do I board?" or "how long have I got?". Singapore Changi (SIN) only. Looks up live flight data and returns terminal, gate, status, estimated boarding time and minutes until boarding.

date.description: Flight date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today Singapore time.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.title: Places to eat, rest and shop at Changi
tools.description: Use when a traveller asks "where can I eat in T3?", "somewhere quiet to rest before my flight" or "what is worth seeing with 3 hours?". Singapore Changi (SIN) only: Terminals 1 to 4 and Jewel. Returns up to 12 hand-picked venues, each with a link to its page. Venues that are closed, or landside when there is not time to clear immigration, are left out.

annotations.title: Places to eat, rest and shop at Changi

terminal.description: Terminal code: SIN-T1, SIN-T2, SIN-T3, SIN-T4, SIN-JEWEL

tools.name: get_disruption_status
tools.title: Flight delays and gate changes
tools.description: Use when a traveller asks "is my flight delayed?", "has my gate changed?" or "was it cancelled?". Singapore Changi (SIN) only. Looks up live flight data and returns any delay, cancellation or gate, with what to do next.

tools.name: get_route
tools.title: Plan a layover at Changi
tools.description: Use when a traveller between flights asks "what should I do with my 4-hour layover?" or "plan my time before the gate". Singapore Changi (SIN) only. Give the arrival terminal and the minutes available; a known flight number (e.g. QF1) can match a hand-made route. Returns stops in order with durations and a buffer for the walk to the gate.

arrival_terminal.description: Terminal the passenger arrived at, e.g. SIN-T1, SIN-T3

departure_terminal.description: Terminal departing from. Defaults to arrival_terminal if same-terminal transit.

time_budget_minutes.description: Total usable minutes between now and when passenger needs to be at departure gate.

flight_number.description: If known, used to match curated route templates (e.g. QF1, SQ322).

vibe.description: Preferred vibe to weight stop selection.

data_sources.amenities: Hand-curated catalogue of Changi venues with editorial notes
data_sources.flights: AeroDataBox live flight data, cached up to 5 minutes
data_sources.routes: Curated route templates for known flight patterns, otherwise composed from the catalogue

trust_signals.catalogue_only: Venues come only from the curated catalogue; none are generated.
trust_signals.opening_hours: Closed venues are left out at the time of the request (Singapore time).
trust_signals.landside_rule: Landside venues such as Jewel are left out when there is not time to clear immigration both ways.
